name: treasury-payments
summary: Treasury agents send Stripe transfers in test mode to named connected accounts: two independent approvers release every transfer, a payee whose bank details changed recently also needs the principal's step-up, transfers above 10000.00 USD are refused, and the agent's grant sends at most 50000.00 USD a week.
protects: transfers go only to the payees named with --payee: a transfer to any other connected account is refused, org-wide, for every agent, and the agent's grant names only those payees
every transfer waits for two independent approvers
a transfer to a payee whose bank details were added or changed within 7 days, or whose bank-detail changes cannot be read, also needs the principal's security-key step-up before it is released
no transfer above 10000.00 USD is made, approved or not
the agent's grant sends at most 50000.00 USD a week (its budget)
every transfer is verified at the domain effect: Stripe reports a transfer to that account for that amount, not reversed
the agent's grant covers creating and reading transfers and reading the balance only
excludes: payouts from a connected account to its bank: only the transfer to the connected account is decided
transfers in currencies other than USD: the cap fails closed (CANNOT_AUTHORIZE) until you add rules for them
whether a payment is owed: the approvers decide from the payee, the amount and the transfer group
transfers made outside PantherClaw (the Stripe dashboard, another integration, a person with the API key) are not seen or limited
Stripe live mode: pc.stripe refuses live keys
people: bind approver yourself (pclaw role bind); at least two different people must hold it
a new payee: apply the template again with every --payee and --update
the thresholds are examples: change them in a new policy version before relying on them
grant: creating transfers to the named payees, reading transfers and the balance; 50000.00 USD of transfers a week

connections: a pc.stripe connection with a restricted test key in enforce mode, which also provides the fact stripe.account.payout_details_changed
